clips.title: The story
paras: The Glowing Shard is a mysterious emerald-hued gem plucked from the dark depths of the Wailing Caverns. Swirling with smoky essence beneath its polished surface, this disturbing relic drives adventurers to seek answers in Ratchet and beyond.

Drawn from deep within the Wailing Caverns, the glowing shard immediately unnerves those who hold it. Brilliant green and seemingly solid, it holds churning, mist-like shadows beneath its crystalline face. The crystal exerts a subtle pull, demanding attention while exuding a deeply unsettling aura that hints at the corrupted nature of the slumbering druids and their nightmare-infested sanctuary.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The shard is a brilliant green, and although solid, what looks like smoke swirls just below the surface. You can't help staring into the depths of the crystal; at the same time, you know there is something very disturbing about it.
Maybe you should see if anyone in Ratchet can tell you more about this strange shard.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh... I have never seen anything like this...
